key_findings: Tarantula peptide Eo1a is the most potent spider-venom NaV1.8 activator (EC50 894 nM), shifting activation and fast inactivation to hyperpolarised voltages.
Nav1.7/Nav1.8 chimeras and the [D24K]Eo1a analogue show the NaV1.8 DII S3-S4 extracellular loop is the binding site; Eo1a evokes pain behaviour reduced in Nav1.8 knockout mice.
